name: codex-cost-orchestrator
description: Implicit cost-aware Codex implementation routing with a Sol control plane, tiered workers, bounded context, and independent review epochs.

interface.shortDescription: Default cost-aware routing with guarded direct execution and verified worker lanes.
interface.longDescription: Codex Cost Orchestrator implicitly classifies implementation work, verifies atomic low-risk edits directly in Sol, routes closed contracts to Luna and bounded complex work to Terra, upgrades without losing the original baseline, and gates orchestrated results through an exact-state review epoch.
defaultPrompt: Implement and verify this feature using the default cost-aware route.
Classify this change, then use the least costly adequate execution lane.
Review this accumulated change set with a fresh review epoch.
